items.name: status-split-pill
items.title: Status Split Pill
items.description: A lifecycle status control: the current status as a dot and label, a menu of allowed transitions, and a chevron that takes the happy-path transition. Ships a read-only badge and a single-transition button.

items.name: progress-circle
items.title: Progress Circle
items.description: A small ring that shows a percentage, for a card or a table cell where a bar would not fit. A progressbar with an optional value label and class slots for the ring.

items.name: confirmation-dialog
items.title: Confirmation Dialog
items.description: A complete confirmation dialog on AlertDialog: a simple yes/no or a typed mode that asks for a phrase first. The footer keeps its buttons on one row at every width, confirm last.
